regions.region: page 1 upper-left graphical abstract reaction arrow
regions.finding: Generic 2,3-allenoate plus allylmagnesium chloride summary (THF, r.t., 2–35 min, 60–100%); classified as a general scheme, not a unique batch.
Conceptual possible 1,2-addition, 1,4-addition, and double-bond-migration pathways for generic R-group substrates; no experimental yield assigned.
Distinct Fe(acac)3-catalyzed trial of 1a with allylmagnesium chloride in toluene at −78 °C for 1.5 h, giving 2a in 85% isolated yield; 1,4-addition product not observed.
Corroborates Table 1 entry 1 as iron-free and defines entry 3 as the 0.4 mmol, THF (5 mL), room-temperature standard experiment; linked to those page-2 rows without duplication.
Prior reviews and cited allene/Grignard work are literature context, not new experiments of this paper.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1 reaction drawing and entries 1–4
regions.finding: Four solvent/temperature optimization experiments were retained row-by-row with times and NMR yields; entry 3 incorporates only the standard scale/volume explicitly stated on page 1.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Table 2 reaction drawing, entries 1–19, and footnotes a–b
regions.finding: Nineteen distinct substrate-scope rows were retained with common 0.4 mmol/3 equiv/1.7 M/THF 5 mL/r.t. header conditions, isolated yields, and times. Footnote a overrides entry 10 to 2 mmol; footnote b identifies 1r as methyl 2,3-butadienoate.
Three distinct experiments retained: bis-allenoate 3 to 4 (82%, dr≈1:1), optically active 1c to 2c (90%, 97% ee), and 1i with 2-methylallylmagnesium chloride to 2s (98%).

regions.region: page 2 right-center negative and diverted-reaction prose
regions.finding: Six reagent-specific outcomes retained separately: three substituted allylmagnesium chlorides and vinylmagnesium chloride gave complicated results; methyl- and phenylmagnesium chloride gave conjugate-addition products.
Narrative points to the four Scheme 2 transformations and the 86% RCM product 8; linked to page-3/4 records without creating duplicate experiments.

regions.region: page 3 upper Scheme 2, four reaction arrows
regions.finding: Four independent transformations inspected: iodocyclization 2i→5 (89%), Pd/allyl bromide cyclization 2i→6 (76%), AgNO3 cyclization 2i→7 (99%), and Grubbs-II RCM 7→8 (86%).
Detailed 0.4 mmol, 3 min, 94% procedure matches Table 2 entry 1 and was merged into that row with charges, nitrogen atmosphere, workup, purification, and product mass.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left/right detailed preparations of 5 and 6
regions.finding: Detailed charges, solvent volumes, workups, chromatography, and product masses support the existing Scheme 2 records; no duplicate records created.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right detailed preparation of 7 (continues characterization on page 4)
regions.finding: Detailed AgNO3-catalyzed batch supports the 2i→7 Scheme 2 record; page-4 continuation is characterization, not a new reaction.

Reagent solution concentrations/solvents were attached to the three complicated-mixture records only where explicitly stated; preparations by cited procedures were not imported as current-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left continuation of product 7 characterization
regions.finding: Continuation of the page-3 2i→7 experiment characterization; no additional reaction record created.

regions.region: page 4 left/upper-right detailed RCM preparation of 8
regions.finding: Grubbs-II-catalyzed RCM of 7 in CH2Cl2 under N2 at reflux for 2 h, with chromatography and 86% isolated yield; merged with Scheme 2. The printed 41.8 mg/0.2 mmol charge is preserved as an unresolved source inconsistency.
The paper states that experimental details and spectra are available as Supporting Information, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated; no SI data were inferred.
No additional reaction experiment; the reproduction acknowledgment does not supply new conditions or results beyond Table 2.
